The Orville does it the old way, you can watch the episodes out of order if you want and not get too confused, which is (subjectively) easier to get into because every episode follows the formula and begins and ends at the same place, as opposed to the drawn out process of story fulfillment Discovery uses as a fully serialized "binge watch" kinda show.
